about: Roadmap v1's model, frozen with it on 26 Nov 2026: the sizes and the estimate rules it was planned with. Read only by scripts/site/roadmap_v1.py.

estimates.about: Splits each story's size into product and development work, and scales both for a team that builds with Claude Code. Read by scripts/site/roadmap.py (npm run roadmap). Every value here is an assumption until Nikhil confirms it.
estimates.source: Nikhil on PR #193 (26 Nov 2026): 10% product work during sprints, design work needs about 25% engineer time with the product manager, and product and development work speed up the same with Claude Code. The factor 0.4 is Claude Code's conservative proposal (PR #193).
estimates.product_share_why: During a sprint the product manager spends a tenth of an engineering story's size on it (refining it, answering questions, accepting it), before the engineer can start. If the product manager is busy, the story waits.
estimates.with_claude_code_why: Product and development work are assumed to speed up the same: 2.5 times (0.4). People still review every pull request and document, test the work and make the decisions, so the work does not disappear.
estimates.joint_share_why: Design work (requirements, metrics, architecture, API, data model, MCP, user journeys and UI) is discussed and reviewed by the product manager and an engineer together: a quarter of a design story is joint sessions, the rest is its owner working alone.
